description: Generate a personal Bible reading plan from a goal in the user's words (e.g. "understand grace", "the life of David") and a length of 30, 60, 90 days. Takes up to a minute. Returns the plan id, name and every day's passage, and starts the plan when the user has no active plan. Free accounts get one generated plan per quarter; the error names when the next one is available.

daily_load.description: How much to read each day: short, medium or deep. Defaults to medium.

day_count.description: Length of the plan in days. One of 30, 60, 90.

goal.description: What the user wants to read toward, in their own words. Up to 1000 characters.

name: create_reading_plan
title: Create reading plan
